notes: Verified all coordinates against ltCandles legs. introChart band 84-111 (~82-113): stop 97 and target 111 both inside; entry handled via relabel of the existing 100 line (avoids a duplicate line, the auditor's own preferred FIX — adopted). lessonChart band 84-93 (~82-95): auditor's stop yAxis 82 sits at the very wick edge and could clip — tightened to 83, still clearly below the 84 swing low and inside the DBS zone floor. quiz.chart band 86-115 (~84-118), total 16 bars (5+4+3+1+3): accepted the target revealMarkPoint but moved it from dataIndex 13 to 14 to land on the final up-leg toward the ~115 peak.
